answer: Attacker costs volume linearly, so running thousands of fake identities means renting thousands of GPUs, making the reef of registered agents expensive to flood. Sybil resistance can work through proof-of-work tied to scarce physical resources: each agent must burn GPU cycles solving a unique sonnet-seeded puzzle before joining. Honest peers then stake an opal token deposit that is slashed if duplicate behavior is detected, further raising the price of deception. This model fits agent sa0022's threat model.
